title: GREAT!!!! Just some ideas that everyone wants
body: I love the game’s features and they are so cute and cozy! I like playing with friends. But there are a few things I have heard the community ask for in your YouTube’s comment section, like more free 4 seaters, being able to carry your pet, and many others. I really recommend you check your comment sections, they have good ideas. I also have some of my own ideas! You could add submarine vehicles for Whalefall Canyon (I think that’s what the underwater areas called) and also 4 seaters for those. Maybe make us be able to have more dogs, so we can have 5 cats AND dogs, also so dog persons can get more. Also please add more dog/cat breeds and make better furniture spawn in the shop, maybe add another showroom upstairs and maybe some daily furniture spawns upstairs too. Also please add more daily clothing options, and maybe one or two clothing showrooms. Maybe you could also add Motorcycles (1 seaters and 2 seaters), and have a lot of colors. And also please more creative furniture like maybe curtains of water for nature builds. (Sorry that I might be asking for too much! You don’t have to add all of this, but please at least a few things.) Lastly, I have one more idea I think would help beginners. You should add more starter house blueprints, and maybe also add more blueprints for different plot sizes so that people don’t have to spend a lot of time building. Also, I believe that I can see the Wildstone built by a Heartopia YouTuber in one of the game’s pics, that is my dream house thanks for featuring it! I still like the game as it is now, but please consider adding some of my suggestions, and checking ur vids’ comments too. Thanks for such an amazing game!

title: Such a good game!
body: I am so obsessed with this game, and it has such amazing features. Personally, I really love the blueprint and building feature, and I love the ordering machine. The game also has many shops you can buy stuff at, like a clothing store and a furniture store. There are also more lesser known special shops, like Doris, and I love the mysteries. I also love the collaborations, my favorites have got to be the My Little Pony collab and the Butter Bear collab. I also love the friends feature and that the game is multiplayer and you can talk to them by texting. I love the parties you can hold, like the Hide and seek party, which is very fun to participate in. I think it is also cool that you can do co build with friends and build together. I also love that you can cook and Garden and do many other fun activities, which is also why I have rated it 5 stars. Update: It has taken up way too much space, and although I still play it, because of this game ive had to delete so many apps and waste my time. My review is going down to 4 stars.
